outcome: Explore a compact Leetcode archive in the current Paper theme, with original-style difficulty colors and scalable search/date/difficulty/many-to-many collection filters; provide desktop, mobile and recovery states using real entry metadata.
boundary: Only the exploration page is writable; preserve its previous direction as archive copies before revision. All other Paper pages, artboards and file-wide tokens are protected.

Combine current Paper warm-paper colors, Eiko/Georgia typography, 720px reading column, masthead, footer and clean side gutters with the original site's compact title/date/difficulty layout and colored difficulty labels.

Categories are overlapping author-defined collections, not algorithm topics. Explore any/all collection matching and options derived from content/collection metadata rather than hardcoded years or a closed taxonomy.
Preserve application source, published writing and all inherited local work; no coded route, dependencies, commit or deployment.

Use actual live titles, dates and difficulties. Clearly label illustrative collection memberships and filter states; do not imply implemented behavior, fabricated publications or new production metadata.
Review desktop/mobile renders and compare protected main-page serialized content; local workflow receipts do not fingerprint remote state.
Retain native scrolling and accessibility intentions; static renders are not browser or assistive-technology certification.
outOfScope: Changes to existing design pages or application code
